newsitem.title: USA: IBP in hog production contracts - analyst.
newsitem.headline: IBP in hog production contracts - analyst.

text.p: Beef and pork producer IBP Inc has entered into contracts with several hog producers to raise animals for the company, and may later go into hog-raising itself, Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said.
Currently, IBP buys hogs for its slaughter plants.
Wittenburg said IBP officials talked about the company's plans for hog production at a Dain Bosworth conference in Minneapolis.
IBP officials were not available for comment.
Wittenburg said IBP told investors it now has contracts with several hog producers for an unspecified level of production to keep IBP's hog plants operating at maximum efficiency.
The analyst said IBP officials added the company could later enter hog production, and could be involved with animal genetics.
